column1: # Lemurian ship departure: the party leaves Gondowan and sets course for Lemuria.

column3: The time has come. We\nleave Gondowan behind.{end_wait}
It feels strange... We've\ncome so far, yet the road\nahead{page_break}seems no closer to its end.{end_wait}
So much has changed\nsince we left home.{end_wait}
Once we find {actor_name:6},\nwill our journey finally\nbe finished?{end_now}
Finished? We would only\nbe standing at the edge\nof another beginning.{end_wait}
Another beginning? What\ncould possibly come after\nall that we've faced?{end_wait}
What do you think\nLemuria will be like?{end_wait}
She will be furious\nwhen I tell {actor_name:6}\nwhat you said!{end_wait}
This is my first time\nseeing the open ocean\nfrom a ship.{end_wait}
So this is the sea\nKraden wanted me to see.\nIt feels endless.{end_wait}
The water is rough.\nAre we certain this ship\ncan weather it?{end_now}
The vessel is Lemurian.\nIt should carry us\nsafely.{end_wait}
I hope you're right.\nStill, there is no\nturning back now...{end_wait}
